subject: Crestline product launch — press timing & quote coordination
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Erin Soto <erin.soto@crestline.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Crestline product launch — press timing & quote coordination

Hi Erin —

Congrats again on the upcoming launch next month. We’d love to coordinate a short customer announcement and include a brief quote from Crestline on how Redwood helped reduce inference costs for your real-time analytics pipeline. Quick asks:

- Is Crestline planning an embargoed press release window? If yes, what date/time (ET) should we hold to?
- Who on your side will sign off on the quote and review the release (name + email)?
- Can you share a high-res logo and any preferred boilerplate?

I’ve looped in Karthik from partnerships to align on the joint comms timeline. We can propose a draft release and sample quotes to speed review.

If it helps, we typically ask for a 48-hour review window for final approvals on embargoed copy.

Thanks —
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: mutual_action_plan_Crestline_Redwood.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Erin Soto <erin.soto@crestline.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Luke Ramos <luke.ramos@crestline.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Crestline product launch — press timing & quote coordination

Ben —

Thanks and excited to do this with you. Quick answers:  
- We are targeting March 10th for the public announcement but planning an embargoed journalist briefing on March 9th at 11:00 AM ET. That embargo time works for us.
- Primary approval will be me (erin.soto@crestline.ai) and Luke Ramos (cc'd) for technical accuracy. Final legal sign-off will come from our comms counsel — we should budget the 48 hours you mentioned.
- I attached a logo pack to this reply. Also, please use our preferred company name: Crestline Analytics (do not use Crestline.ai in the headline).

We can review a short draft quote — would prefer something that highlights latency improvements and lower inferencing cost per query.

Thanks —
Erin
VP Product & Partnerships | Crestline Analytics

--
Attachment: crestline_logo_pack_v2.zip (images)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Crestline product launch — press timing & quote coordination

Folks — forwarding Erin's note. Key timeline: embargoed briefing Mar 9 @ 11:00 AM ET, public Mar 10. External approvals: Erin + Luke, plus their counsel.

Monica — can you draft a short announcement (350–450 words) + two quote options? One technical and one customer-success-style. We should:
- Lead with the customer impact (latency, cost per inference)
- Include a short demo callout and link to the joint case study page (placeholder)

Laura — please advise if we need any language for legal that typically slows approvals for customers (IP callouts, performance claims).

Erin — I’ll send a clean draft once we have internal PR copy and sample quotes.

Thanks —
Ben

Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Draft press release + sample quotes for Crestline announcement (embargo Mar 9)

Hi Erin —

Thanks again — attached is a short draft release and two suggested quotes. We aimed for a ~375-word announcement and included a technical blurb for journalists.

Sample quotes (option A/B):

A) "Partnering with Redwood, Crestline Analytics reduced median inference latency by 45% and cut per-query cost by over 30%, enabling real-time analytics at scale." — Erin Soto, VP Product, Crestline Analytics

B) "Using Redwood's inference platform, our engineering team launched a production-grade real-time analytics pipeline in weeks, not months, and achieved meaningful cost savings." — Erin Soto, VP Product, Crestline Analytics

Could you review and tell us which quote you prefer and any edits you want? We intentionally avoided specific dollar figures; if you want more precise cost metrics we can add with your okay.

Attachments: redwood_crestline_draft_press_release_v1.docx (docx)

Best,
Monica Patel
Head of PR | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.inference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft press release + sample quotes for Crestline announcement (embargo Mar 9)

All —

Thanks, Monica. High level legal OK, just two small asks to speed approval:

1) Replace "reduced median inference latency by 45%" with "reduced typical inference latency by approximately 45%" — softer wording avoids an overly specific performance claim.
2) Add a short sentence noting that Crestline provided performance figures based on their internal benchmarks run on production traffic during Q4 2026.

If we make those two edits, legal sign-off should be straightforward and we can still meet your 48-hour review window.

Laura
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com

Subject: Re: Draft press release + sample quotes for Crestline announcement (embargo Mar 9)

Monica / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We prefer quote A but with Laura's softening applied. Updated preferred quote:

"Partnering with Redwood, Crestline Analytics reduced typical inference latency by approximately 45% and cut per-query cost by over 30%, enabling real-time analytics at scale." — Erin Soto, VP Product, Crestline Analytics

We’ve reviewed the draft and the added context about internal production benchmarks is fine. Luke will run one last technical check today but we expect no changes. 

Please send the revised release (with Laura's two edits) by end of day PT and we'll aim to return formal approval within 24–36 hours.

Also confirming we will provide the high-res logo pack you already received and that we do not want "Crestline.ai" used in the headline.

Best,
Erin

Attached is the revised release with Laura's edits and the preferred quote. We also included a short demo scheduling link and a checklist for the embargoed briefing.

Next steps:
- Please confirm final approval by EOD PT Friday (Feb 19) so we can distribute embargoed copy to select journalists on Mar 8 and host the briefing on Mar 9 at 11:00 AM ET.
- Confirm the right PR contact for day-of logistics (phone number and availability window).

Thanks again — excited to launch together.

Cheers,
Ben
